# Procyon Technostructure

> Procyon Technostructure is an enterprise solution delivery organization providing customer-centric, secure solutions. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Novato, California, with delivery centers in Toronto, Canada and Chennai, India. 200+ architects, engineers and consultants; 200+ enterprise clients. Salesforce Consulting Partner and ServiceNow Implementation Partner. ISO 27001 and ISO 9001:2015 certified, HIPAA-compliant delivery, WBE, NMSDC and SBE certified. Tagline: "Run the business. Not the software."

## What Procyon does
- Digital transformation: one accountable team across CRM, IT service management, AI, data and custom engineering.
- Salesforce consulting, implementation, org audits and managed services: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service, Revenue Cloud and CPQ, Data Cloud, Experience Cloud, Health Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, MuleSoft, Tableau.
- Agentforce implementation, including the Agent Launch Kit (first agents in production in under 4 weeks).
- ServiceNow platform audits and tech-debt removal (8-week remediation), ITSM, ITOM and CMDB, Security Operations, GRC, Now Assist and AI agents.
- AI and data: AI agents, RAG knowledge assistants, predictive scoring, LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI), big data and analytics, data governance.
- Integration: MuleSoft, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite and Workday integration, API-first and event-driven architecture.
- Product engineering: custom web and mobile applications (enterprise web and mobility), application modernization, application maintenance and support, cloud transformation, cybersecurity and compliance.
- Talent: certified Salesforce and ServiceNow staff augmentation, dedicated delivery pods, managed services.
- Ranger Fusion: an ERP built natively on Salesforce (sales, finance, inventory, procurement, projects, HR).

## Salesforce pages
- [Salesforce consulting](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/salesforce): implementation, Agentforce, Data Cloud, org rescue and managed services from one certified Salesforce team; 40+ accelerators cut timelines by 30 to 50%.
- [Salesforce implementation](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/salesforce/implementation): fixed-scope starters, Sales Cloud live in 6 weeks and Service Cloud in 8; six-phase delivery with a sign-off at each gate.
- [Agentforce implementation](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/salesforce/agentforce): Agent Launch Kit puts first AI agents into production in under 4 weeks; use-case library and guardrails; 60% of tier-1 queries resolved by agents in a healthcare rollout.
- [Data Cloud and integration](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/salesforce/data-cloud): unified real-time customer profiles; MuleSoft and API integration with SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Snowflake and Databricks; GDPR, CCPA and HIPAA governance.
- [Org audit and rescue](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/salesforce/org-audit): 8-area Salesforce org health check and a 30-day stabilization plan for orgs that have drifted.
- [Salesforce managed services](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/salesforce/managed-services): Run, Improve and Scale tiers; release readiness for Spring, Summer and Winter; hubs in Novato, Toronto and Chennai.
- [Ranger Fusion](https://procyonts.com/products/ranger-fusion): native Salesforce ERP for sales, finance, inventory, procurement, projects and HR on one data model; live in 2 to 4 weeks; typical savings of 20 to 60% against a patchwork stack.

## ServiceNow pages
- [ServiceNow practice](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/servicenow): ServiceNow Implementation Partner; every engagement starts with a 2 to 3 week platform health check; ITSM, ITOM, SecOps, GRC, Customer and Field Service, HR Service Delivery and Now Assist on a fixed SOW with zero-markup pass-through costs. Delivered for the Administrative Office of the Courts (60% fewer integration failures, 40 to 50% faster root cause analysis), NIH NIAAA (audit-ready from go-live) and City of Glendale Water & Power (10+ systems on one platform).
- [Platform audit and tech-debt removal](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/servicenow/platform-audit): CMDB integrity, workflow configuration, integration health and licensed utilization audited; typical instances run at 30 to 40% of licensed capacity; tech-debt removal in about 8 weeks.
- [ITSM, ITOM and CMDB](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/servicenow/itsm-itom): incident, problem, change, catalog, Discovery, Service Graph and event management, implemented CMDB-first.
- [Security and risk](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/servicenow/security-risk): Vulnerability Response, Security Incident Response, continuous compliance, integrated and vendor risk, AI Control Tower; HIPAA, NIST, FedRAMP and SOC 2.
- [Now Assist and AI agents](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/servicenow/now-assist): 4-week discovery, first production agent in about 8 weeks, 90-day platform setup; AI Control Tower implemented in production.
- [ServiceNow managed services](https://procyonts.com/enterprise/servicenow/managed-services): admin, twice-yearly upgrade readiness, CMDB hygiene, integration monitoring; 24/7 global delivery support; no managed services lock-in.
- [Cloud transformation](https://procyonts.com/services/cloud): AWS, Azure and Google Cloud landing zones, 6Rs migration, platform engineering, FinOps and 24x7 SRE operations; 40% average cost reduction; 300+ workloads moved.
- [Cybersecurity and compliance](https://procyonts.com/services/cybersecurity): SOC in a Box 24x7 managed detection and response, CISO Genie continuous GRC, advisory and assessments; tool costs passed through at zero markup; free 2-hour exploration.

## AI and data pages
- [AI and data services](https://procyonts.com/ai-data): agentic AI, knowledge assistants, data platforms, integration and product engineering for regulated enterprises, in production on AWS, Azure, GCP, Salesforce, ServiceNow and SAP. Client results: AOC statewide judicial system (60% fewer submission failures), NIH NIAAA clinical research (federal audit-ready), City of Glendale Water & Power (10+ systems unified, 15-day MW forecasting pipeline).
- [AI agents and automation](https://procyonts.com/services/ai-ml): multi-agent orchestration and workflow automation with governance built in; clinical intake from 4 hours to 12 minutes; compliance evidence 3x faster; LangGraph, CrewAI, Bedrock Agents, Azure AI Agent Service, ServiceNow AI Control Tower.
- [Knowledge assistants](https://procyonts.com/ai-data/knowledge-assistants): retrieval-augmented assistants answering from SharePoint, Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow and PDFs with citations and permission-aware retrieval; Enterprise RAG Starter.
- [Data platforms and analytics](https://procyonts.com/services/data-analytics): Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery and Synapse; Tableau, Power BI and Looker on a governed semantic layer; 100+ data platforms delivered.
- [Integration and APIs](https://procyonts.com/solutions/enterprise-integration): MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Kafka and EventBridge; SAP, Oracle, NetSuite and Workday integration; B2B and EDI; 500+ APIs in production.
- [Product engineering](https://procyonts.com/solutions/enterprise-application-modernization): custom web and mobile products, application modernization (rehost, replatform, refactor, repurchase, retire, retain), cloud transformation on AWS, Azure and GCP, application support.

## Talent pages
- [Staff augmentation](https://procyonts.com/services/staff-augmentation): pre-vetted Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Workday, Oracle, cloud, data, AI, engineering and project leadership talent by the seat; 1,500+ vetted consultants; shortlist within 72 hours for most roles; onboarded in 7 to 14 days; technical screen, scenario interview, communication assessment and reference checks; no-questions-asked replacement guarantee; US-cleared talent for public sector; onshore US, nearshore Canada, offshore India.
- [Delivery pods](https://procyonts.com/talent/delivery-pods): cross-functional Salesforce, ServiceNow, AI and data, product engineering and run pods with shared accountability; scale up or down within two weeks.
- [Engagement models](https://procyonts.com/talent/engagement-models): fixed scope, time and materials, milestone-based, outcome-based and managed capacity; onshore, nearshore and offshore blends at predictable rates.
